entities.summary: Jean-Pierre Grin stylized as Jean-Pierre Grin-Hofmann is a Swiss farmer and politician. He served as a member of the National Council (Switzerland) for the Swiss People's Party from 2007 until 2023. Grin was a member of the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe. He previously served as a member of the Cantonal Council of Vaud from 1998 to 2007.
